title: Evaluation of the all-ones circuit
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every assignment $x : \mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\mathrm{Fin}(2)$, the all-ones circuit evaluates to $\prod_{i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)}x(i)$ in $\mathrm{Fin}(2)$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns an element of $\mathrm{Fin}(2)$ to each element of $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$
